name: EPIC 211828487
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 7.1 solar radii and 1.13 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211828487 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.142881 (16th-84th percentiles 6.895863-7.405843), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,515 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.13 solar masses and 7.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,830 K at its surface.
